inputs: No application body; current session and same-origin request.

effects: Updates bounded last-active evidence, not other users’ activity.

inputs: Current session; shared export request budget.
outputs: Private no-store JSON attachment; safe failure responses.
effects: Reads explicit owner-scoped projections including usage/subscription state; no refresh token.
Dismisses only an owner notice via dismissAccountNotice.

inputs: Auth.js-managed OAuth/session request and callback data.
effects: Delegates to handlers from auth.ts; OAuth entrypoints validate provider identity before a session exists.

outputs: {checkoutUrl} or mapped BillingError; 413/400 for oversize/invalid JSON.
effects: Creates durable attempt/customer/session with provider writes outside short owner transactions.

inputs: Session, origin, shared management budget and bounded JSON cancellation input.
outputs: Cancellation workflow result or mapped failure.
effects: Calls cancelBillingSubscription and retains provider cancellation recovery state.

inputs: Session, origin and shared management budget; no application body.
effects: Reads bound customer and calls provider portal creation; current host validation is test-specific.

outputs: Private billing/access observation including configured mode, deadlines and checkout state.
effects: Reads durable observations without trusting return parameters.

inputs: Inngest-managed service request and signature protocol.
effects: Registers eight functions. Correct deployed signing/registration is external configuration.

outputs: Private no-store quota snapshot; 401 unauthenticated, 503 unavailable.
effects: Reads fresh gated snapshot or a reduced legacy response including used/limit/notices/accessVersion.

outputs: {ok:true}; 401/403/413/400 for denied, too-large or invalid upload.
effects: Development local-storage branch validates PDF and activates it. Production/local-Blob mismatch is rejected by storage helper.

inputs: User authorization/origin/path for token issuance; SDK-verified service completion branch.
outputs: SDK upload-token/callback result; 503 cleanup failure or 400 safe failure.

inputs: Current session and current owner-selected attachment.
outputs: Private PDF attachment; 401/403/404 for missing owner/file/read failure.
effects: Reads only the owner path and supplies nosniff/no-store headers.

inputs: Session, shared export budget and UUID route parameter.
outputs: Private JSON template attachment; 401/404 and limiter errors.
effects: Reads owner/deletion-scoped selected template fields; no mutation of the template.
